speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I see you are a newborn presenting with respiratory distress; could you please describe the onset and severity of the breathing difficulties, and let me know if there were any complications during the delivery?

speaker: Patient
text: Newborn, born at 33 weeks of gestation. The newborn is presenting with respiratory distress 2 hours after birth. The mother had an uneventful pregnancy until premature onset of labor. There was no significant prenatal care history mentioned.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given the prematurity and early onset of distress, I suspect Hyaline Membrane Disease. REQUEST TEST: Chest_X-Ray.

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Chest Radiograph shows fine reticular granulation with ground glass appearance on both lungs

speaker: Doctor
text: The radiographic findings of ground-glass appearance and reticular granulation in a premature infant are classic for Respiratory Distress Syndrome. DIAGNOSIS READY: Neonatal Respiratory Distress Syndrome (Hyaline Membrane Disease)
